title: Replace Heuristic Off-Center Shot Study Contact with Consistent Two-Body Impulses
acceptance: Existing off-center API uses scalar effective mass then additive gear spin without matching club rotation; toe spin sign conflicts with flight frame. Implement a separate explicit two-body inertia/contact law for research, independently test momentum, passivity, restitution, covariance, central limit and toe/high-face directions. Document assumed CG/inertias and lack of empirical qualification; no accuracy claim from conservation alone.
